clockPolicy.queryTime: capture actual local query clock; do not freeze today to 2026-10-04 or rewrite original timestamps
clockPolicy.plannerToday: same captured local calendar day; production validate_request allows at most one UTC civil-day difference
clockPolicy.dateRange: model-selected inclusive local calendar dates; frontend queryDateRange supplies epoch bounds at local midnights and exclusive next-day end
clockPolicy.legacySourceTurnLocalDatesInAsiaSeoul: All nine original turn timestamps fall on the same UTC and Asia/Seoul calendar day; file creation/import/modified timestamps are not turn/event dates
clockPolicy.periodCoverage: Compare original reference facts only for actually admitted source turns inside the selected period; disclose separately if the chosen period omits useful historical sources. Never replace the model period with originalActivityPeriod.

retrievalLimits.D4ThreeTurnContainer: Keep all three original turns in one file. Native raw recall may admit only its newest two selected-period turns and mark incomplete; record that omission, do not split the file or preload its missing turn.
retrievalLimits.sourceClosure: Later native resolution is observed, never injected into the initial hit list.

nativeBindingRecipe.nativeSpanScope: base bind_original_page admission; later windows may reissue IDs
nativeBindingRecipe.passagePreservation: Exact original turn text remains a contiguous subrange. Original separators are retained between turns; inserted role headers interrupt whole-document contiguity. Remove inserted headers and frontmatter to reconstruct source.original.
nativeBindingRecipe.nativeBodyDifference: For non-final turns, original inter-turn separator bytes belong to the native body and are included in its SHA256. Do not substitute the original passage SHA for the full native body SHA.

preservation: Existing source artifact, its original passages, source timestamps/speakers/phases, original gold and prior manifests are unchanged. This new corpus changes only transcript container representation; all derived full-file hashes and offsets are new.
